guardaxis.problem: Security tools often fail when one source degrades, leaving teams with noisy alerts and weak context during active threat stages.
architecture: FastAPI coordinates detector execution, source scoring, and fallback branches.
React surfaces attack stage, detector confidence, and remediation context.
Docker and GitHub Actions keep local and deployment environments reproducible.
decisions: Use a 4-source threat-scoring engine rather than depending on one detector stream.
Map 14+ detectors across reconnaissance, exploitation, persistence, lateral movement, and exfiltration.
Add multi-layer fallback logic so detector degradation does not cascade through the workflow.
guardaxis.codeSnippet:
async def score_threat(event):
    signals = await detector_pool.run(event)
    confidence = weighted_score(signals)
    return fallback_policy(confidence, signals)

credgen-ai.problem: Loan underwriting becomes slow when credit scoring, anomaly review, and applicant communication happen in separate manual workflows.
architecture: FastAPI orchestrates five agents for intake, scoring, anomaly checks, explanation, and chat response.
XGBoost handles credit scoring while PyOD flags unusual application patterns.
PostgreSQL stores applicant records and Ollama powers natural-language loan queries.
decisions: Separate scoring and anomaly detection so each model remains independently testable.
Treat the chatbot as an explanation layer over structured underwriting state.
Prioritize measurable reductions in manual effort and processing time.

linguai.problem: Learners need adaptive language practice without every grammar and vocabulary exercise being manually authored.
architecture: FastAPI exposes authenticated learner, progress, and exercise endpoints.
React and Redux manage session state, learner context, and generated tasks.
Gemini API generates grammar and vocabulary drills based on learner level.
decisions: Use JWT and role-based access control to separate learner and admin flows.
Keep AI generation scoped to exercise creation for predictable UX.
Use Vite optimisation to reduce frontend load time across repeat sessions.

multi-digit-recognition.problem: Single-digit classifiers do not solve real handwritten input unless multiple digits are segmented before inference.
architecture: Preprocessing isolates digit regions from handwritten input.
A TensorFlow/Keras CNN classifies each segmented candidate.
The inference path returns a combined prediction in under two seconds.
decisions: Focus on segmentation quality because bad crops erase gains from model accuracy.
Use a compact CNN architecture trained on MNIST for repeatable results.
Keep inference lightweight enough for real-time demos.
